title: Live (live.json of a live product)
description: The document of the product live: the chart's score files, the band and the jacket, and the manifest paths of the products the live plays with. Only the keys the player reads are described. See docs/data-format.md.

band.description: The band whose start timeline and background the live plays (a key of scene.json bands).

notes.description: The score, a file of the live.

notesMirror.description: Optional: the score converted with the MirrorChart option.

parts.description: Part -> the manifest path of the product, relative to the layout root.
